entities.summary: The Nakajima Ki-115 Tsurugi  is a single-seat aircraft that was developed specifically for kamikaze use by the Imperial Japanese Army Air Force during the closing stages of World War II in 1945. The Imperial Japanese Navy called this aircraft Tōka.
